Name: Grandpa's Abandoned Farm
Author: Khatarina
Description:
This is sort of inspired by KatsAtelier's overgrown farm mod, here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32794 since I agree that the default farms are not really worthy of the title 'overgrown'.  But that one didn't do it for me either, because a forested area simply does not have all the trees full-grown, with no underbrush or empty spaces, etc.
So I created my own version.  Thanks to Button on the SV Discord server for pointing me in the direction of the right coding to make the pond work the way I wanted it to.

I think I have all the required packages listed, but this is my first try at a mod, so I might have missed something.  I do suggest using Glymr's Broken Farmhouse for the full effect, but it's not required.  Sharogg's tilesheets are necessary for the bridges to show up properly, and unlockable bundles to build them.  And I do know the waterfall is a bit 'off'...  I couldn't find a waterfall that would fit the placement properly, and it's not that noticeable.  Also, I am not quite sure why the farmer keeps resetting to the cabin during the events.  If anyone can tell me what I'm doing wrong there, I'll be grateful.

The pool has three options.  You can swim all year round, (for those insane members of the polar bear club,) have the pond frozen over in the winter with some fishing holes, or have it open but not usable for swimming in the winter.  Also, because you had to get into the house somehow to begin with, it is relatively easy to make it from the door of the house to the exit to the bus stop.  It also gives you an opportunity to refill your energy so you're not spending most of the first few days sleeping.

This isn't set up for multiplayer, because I play solo, and I play on my computer, so no guarantee that it will work on other platforms, though I don't see why it wouldn't.
